annotations.title: Import a PDF into the editor

description: Returns a link (valid 24 hours) that opens an existing PDF in the ReflowPDF editor's import, which rebuilds it as an editable document. A PDF made by ReflowPDF opens from its own source at once; any other is rebuilt by AI, which needs a free account and uses its AI pages (the editor shows the cost first). Give a public https URL of the PDF, or its bytes in base64 (small files).

name.description: The document's name. Default: the file's.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF's bytes, base64 (up to 20 MB).

url.description: A public https address of the PDF.

name: import_pdf
